mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, measured by quarter-over-quarter percent change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of quarters with positive GDP acceleration, or GDP acceleration explains less than 10% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.1) in walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth (year-over-year percent change) exceeds 4%, it signals strong demand that will boost corporate revenues and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months when INDPRO growth exceeds 4%, or the signal explains less than 5% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.05) in walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate (0.3 percentage points or more) over 3 months signals an overheating labor market that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of 3-month periods with UNRATE declines > 0.3pp, or the signal explains less than 10% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.1) in walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that will suppress economic activity and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4%, or the signal explains less than 5% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.05) in walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth (year-over-year percent change) exceeds 10%, it signals an overextended housing market that will soon reverse, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months when HOUST growth exceeds 10%, or the signal explains less than 10% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.1) in walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth (3-month moving average) exceeds 250,000 jobs per month, it signals an overheating labor market that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months when PAYEMS 3mo MA exceeds 250K jobs/mo, or the signal explains less than 5% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.05) in walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (year-over-year percent change) exceeds 3% and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals a dangerous mix of high inflation and loose monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2%, or the signal explains less than 10% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.1) in walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: When real consumer spending (RSAFS) growth (year-over-year percent change) is negative for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY growth is negative for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months when RSAFS YoY growth is negative for 2 consecutive months, or the signal explains less than 5% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.05) in walk-forward regression.
